name: Open-face Chinese poker
summary: A 2-4 player poker variant where players build three ordered poker hands from 13 cards dealt sequentially for points.
rules_text: Each player builds a 13-card hand divided into front (3 cards), middle (5) and back (5). Players are dealt 5 cards face up initially, then one card per turn for 8 more turns, clockwise, starting left of dealer. Each dealt card must be placed in any incomplete row and cannot be moved afterward. When a row is full, remaining cards must go elsewhere. Final hands must satisfy back >= middle >= front in poker strength; front cannot be straight or flush; best front is trips. A foul (illegal ordering) forfeits the hand: fouler loses 6 points to each non-fouler plus royalties and loses own royalties. Scoring: 1 point per row won vs each opponent, +3 bonus for winning all three rows (scoop). Royalty bonuses are paid for strong hands regardless of row win if hand is legal. Fantasyland bonus (QQx+ in front without fouling) gives next hand all 13 cards at once while others play open-face.
